mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, site_id AS siteId, source_coordinate_system_id AS sourceCoordinateSystemId, target_coordinate_system_id AS targetCoordinateSystemId, version_number AS versionNumber, algorithm, parameters::text AS parametersJson, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status, content_hash AS contentHash, published_at AS publishedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, version FROM mine_coordinate_transform_version WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND site_id = #{siteId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY source_coordinate_system_id, target_coordinate_system_id, version_number DESC, id OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
